rows: Let me take the plan in stages. Give me something specific to prove in the ring.
The order matters to me, so let me set it out. Turning up, every time, is the reputation I want.
I work hard at control, and I wish people could see it. I will not threaten anyone's body.
I like to check each part before I move. When it gets tough, I ask for one clear thing.
Turning up, every time, is the reputation I want. Two things matter here, and I will name both.
Under strain, I say what I need in one breath. I want to be the partner who is always ready when the bell goes.
I want the people in the locker room to rely on me.
A contest should leave both of us standing. Two things matter here, and I will name both.
Let us see who wins a straight test of skill.
Speaking for me without permission gets a reply. Test me properly, and I will test you back.
Strength is only part of what I bring to the ring. First, I want to be sure of the order.
I will not make a threat about someone's health. I narrow everything down to one demand under strain.
I want my word to mean something to the people I work with.
Speaking for me without permission gets a reply.
My mind is as trained as my body, and I want that known. The only thing I want to damage is the opponent's confidence in the ring.
Start with the facts, then the moves. Being seen as a brawler with no brain is my fear.
Under pressure I keep the request to a single line.
I want to be the partner nobody has to worry about. One step, then the next, then the rest.
I will not make a threat about someone's health.
I would rather be slow and right. The ring is the place for a straight, fair test.
I trim my message to one thing I need. Turning up, every time, is the reputation I want.
Put a fair test in front of me and let us see.
I will not threaten anyone's body.
First, I want to be sure of the order. I want to be the one people choose when they need a steady hand.
Being seen as a brawler with no brain is my fear. You do not get to speak on my behalf.
I say one plain thing and hold to it.
Partners should never have to wonder if I will show up.
I want to look after my partners as well as myself. Nobody gets hurt because of a threat from me.
I like to check each part before I move. I want to be trusted with the hard parts of a match.
I will not threaten anyone's body.
Pressure makes me reduce the request to a single point. Put a fair test in front of me and let us see.
Speaking for me without permission gets a reply. I would rather be slow and right.
